acceptance_checks.given: a fresh or previously migrated Jin root
acceptance_checks.then: additive schema migration SHALL complete idempotently without modifying canonical task or event files

acceptance_checks.given: Notification Center is first enabled on an existing root
acceptance_checks.then: the center SHALL exclude ended invitations and already delivered historical reminder occurrences

acceptance_checks.given: the same source key and source revision is reconciled repeatedly
acceptance_checks.then: exactly one notification item SHALL exist

acceptance_checks.given: an existing source receives a newer source revision while continuously actionable
acceptance_checks.then: the item SHALL retain its read defer and dismiss state

acceptance_checks.given: a client submits an outdated expected item version
acceptance_checks.then: the backend SHALL return `stale_item` with the current item without applying the mutation

acceptance_checks.given: an invitation source is cancelled missing ended or no longer eligible
acceptance_checks.then: its current item SHALL become `obsolete`

acceptance_checks.given: a terminal item is older than 30 days
acceptance_checks.then: the item SHALL be pruned without mutating its canonical source

acceptance_checks.given: an actionable item is deferred to a future instant
acceptance_checks.when: normal list and summary queries run before that instant
acceptance_checks.then: the item SHALL be excluded from visible results and unread badge count

acceptance_checks.given: a deferred item's visible time has arrived
acceptance_checks.then: the item SHALL become visible and unread

acceptance_checks.given: a due task reminder occurrence is claimed
acceptance_checks.then: its Notification Center item SHALL commit before the occurrence is marked delivered

acceptance_checks.given: native notification permission is denied or submission fails
acceptance_checks.when: a task reminder is delivered to the center
acceptance_checks.then: the durable task reminder item SHALL remain actionable

acceptance_checks.given: a crash occurs after center insertion but before reminder delivery acknowledgement
acceptance_checks.then: reconciliation SHALL converge without a duplicate center item

acceptance_checks.given: a task-reminder item refers to a currently open task
acceptance_checks.then: the item SHALL become acted only after the canonical task completion succeeds

acceptance_checks.given: a task is completed or deleted outside Notification Center
acceptance_checks.then: its remaining reminder items SHALL become obsolete

acceptance_checks.given: native submission has not succeeded
acceptance_checks.then: reminder occurrence delivery truth SHALL depend on durable center insertion rather than native delivery

acceptance_checks.given: a canonical Google event has a non-self organizer and exactly one `self=true` attendee with `needsAction`
acceptance_checks.when: invitation reconciliation runs before the event ends
acceptance_checks.then: the center SHALL contain one actionable invitation item

acceptance_checks.given: the connected account is the event organizer
acceptance_checks.when: invitation reconciliation or RSVP validation runs
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL reject invitation action as `organizer_owned`

acceptance_checks.given: no attendee has `self=true`
acceptance_checks.when: invitation reconciliation or RSVP validation runs
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL reject invitation action as `self_attendee_missing`

acceptance_checks.given: more than one attendee has `self=true`
acceptance_checks.when: invitation reconciliation or RSVP validation runs
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL reject invitation action as `self_attendee_ambiguous`

acceptance_checks.given: canonical Google invitation sources are available
acceptance_checks.then: invitation eligibility SHALL be derived from canonical events by backend code rather than the attendee-omitting indexed event DTO

acceptance_checks.given: two accounts contain equal calendar IDs and Google event IDs
acceptance_checks.when: invitation reconciliation or response routing runs
acceptance_checks.then: their invitation items and response operations SHALL remain independently addressable

acceptance_checks.given: generated recurring instances inherit one pending master invitation
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL emit one master item rather than one item per generated instance

acceptance_checks.given: a detached recurrence exception has its own Google identity or response state
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL preserve it as an independently actionable source

acceptance_checks.given: an invitation is answered outside Jin
acceptance_checks.when: account sync reconciles the new self response
acceptance_checks.then: its item SHALL resolve as acted with external origin

acceptance_checks.given: Allow Maybe or Refuse is accepted by the RSVP service
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL map the choice respectively to `accepted` `tentative` or `declined`

acceptance_checks.given: an eligible RSVP intent
acceptance_checks.when: its Google PATCH body is serialized
acceptance_checks.then: the body SHALL contain only one self attendee email and responseStatus plus `attendeesOmitted=true`

acceptance_checks.given: an MVP RSVP provider request is constructed
acceptance_checks.then: every MVP RSVP provider request SHALL set `sendUpdates=none`

acceptance_checks.given: canonical `attendees_omitted` is true false or absent
acceptance_checks.then: canonical `attendees_omitted` SHALL remain byte-for-byte unchanged

acceptance_checks.given: an RSVP is permitted on an otherwise non-editable external event
acceptance_checks.then: generic edit delete organizer and attendee-edit capabilities SHALL remain disabled

acceptance_checks.given: an eligible invitation has an exact account calendar event and recurrence route
acceptance_checks.then: its outbox operation SHALL retain that exact route without alias or default fallback

acceptance_checks.given: one operation ID is replayed with byte-identical RSVP intent
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL return the recorded outcome without a second canonical mutation or outbox row

acceptance_checks.given: one operation ID is reused with different RSVP intent
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL return `idempotency_conflict` without mutation

acceptance_checks.given: a valid RSVP is accepted into the recoverable mutation boundary
acceptance_checks.when: center intent and outbox durability complete
acceptance_checks.then: the center item SHALL show `action_pending` with the requested choice

acceptance_checks.given: the device is offline but authenticated and route-valid
acceptance_checks.when: an accepted RSVP is projected or recovered
acceptance_checks.then: an accepted RSVP SHALL remain durably queued and visible as Pending sync

acceptance_checks.given: the account is disconnected reauthentication-required or route-invalid
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL leave the item active without changing canonical response status

acceptance_checks.given: Google returns HTTP 412 for an RSVP PATCH
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL fetch the exact remote event before considering one retry

acceptance_checks.given: the 412 refetch already contains the requested self response
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL complete the operation without another PATCH

acceptance_checks.given: the 412 refetch remains eligible with a new etag
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL issue exactly one narrow PATCH using the refreshed `If-Match`

acceptance_checks.given: the controlled RSVP retry returns another 412 or eligibility changes
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL apply the normative active superseded or obsolete outcome without overwriting remote state

acceptance_checks.given: any RSVP precondition fails
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL never issue an unconditional PATCH

acceptance_checks.given: a recurring invitation instance
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL target the exact instance while preserving original-start identity

acceptance_checks.given: a recurring invitation with a resolvable master
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL target the master while preserving recurrence and timezone semantics

acceptance_checks.given: a caller requests This and following
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL reject the request before canonical or outbox mutation

acceptance_checks.given: Notification Center has visible unread items
acceptance_checks.then: the Notifications sidebar bell SHALL expose the backend unread count in text-accessible form

acceptance_checks.given: desktop viewport width
acceptance_checks.then: Notification Center SHALL render a keyboard-operable list and detail workspace

acceptance_checks.given: mobile viewport width
acceptance_checks.when: the Notifications route renders and detail navigation occurs
acceptance_checks.then: Notification Center SHALL render one column with Back restoring list focus and scroll

acceptance_checks.given: an invitation item is rendered
acceptance_checks.then: the UI SHALL show organizer account time location View event and text buttons Allow Maybe Refuse

acceptance_checks.given: an invitation response is submitting or queued
acceptance_checks.when: the selected invitation action group renders
acceptance_checks.then: its competing actions SHALL be disabled with `aria-busy` and a polite live-region update

acceptance_checks.given: a task reminder item is rendered
acceptance_checks.then: the UI SHALL offer Open task Mark done read or unread defer and dismiss without implying provider response

acceptance_checks.given: notification DTO fixtures cross the core bridge and frontend boundary
acceptance_checks.then: Rust Tauri and TypeScript notification DTO fixtures SHALL serialize the same tagged union fields and closed enum values

acceptance_checks.given: a crash occurs after center intent commits but before RSVP outbox insertion
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL resume the same operation ID or return the item active with a validation error

acceptance_checks.given: a crash occurs after RSVP outbox insertion but before the center queued mirror
acceptance_checks.when: startup saga reconciliation joins by operation ID
acceptance_checks.then: the attempt SHALL converge to queued without a duplicate outbox row

acceptance_checks.given: provider and canonical success commit before the center item becomes acted
acceptance_checks.when: startup saga reconciliation joins the successful operation
acceptance_checks.then: the item SHALL become acted without another provider PATCH

acceptance_checks.given: an RSVP operation is preparing queued sending or retryable
acceptance_checks.when: canonical state and notification DTOs are projected
acceptance_checks.then: canonical attendee responseStatus SHALL remain provider-confirmed while DTOs show a pending overlay

acceptance_checks.given: auth generation route generation or provider subject differs from the queued RSVP snapshot
acceptance_checks.then: it SHALL quarantine the operation before network access and disable item RSVP controls

acceptance_checks.given: a 412 refetch contains a self response different from the pending requested response
acceptance_checks.then: the item and attempt SHALL become superseded with both choices preserved

acceptance_checks.given: a pending invitation is cancelled deleted or ended
acceptance_checks.then: the item and attempt SHALL become obsolete without retry

acceptance_checks.given: one account event or canonical file fails during invitation scanning
acceptance_checks.then: healthy sources SHALL still commit while the failed source records a bounded error

acceptance_checks.given: Notification Center SQLite is corrupt or a migration cannot commit
acceptance_checks.then: Jin SHALL fail safely or rebuild current actionable projections without rewriting canonical sources

acceptance_checks.given: items are inserted while a multi-page list traversal is active
acceptance_checks.when: the next cursor page is requested
acceptance_checks.then: snapshot-watermark pagination SHALL return no duplicate or skipped preexisting item

acceptance_checks.given: notification provider failures are recorded or reported
acceptance_checks.when: errors logs or telemetry are serialized
acceptance_checks.then: notification provider errors logs and telemetry SHALL exclude tokens raw provider bodies and full attendee lists

acceptance_checks.given: a keyboard-only user is on Notification Center
acceptance_checks.when: the user navigates and activates the interface
acceptance_checks.then: filters list rows details action groups and recurrence dialog SHALL be operable in visual focus order

acceptance_checks.given: an action completes fails or returns stale state
acceptance_checks.when: the UI rerenders the selected item
acceptance_checks.then: focus SHALL return to a valid control and a polite live region SHALL announce the outcome once

acceptance_checks.given: Notification Center renders any interactive or status state
acceptance_checks.when: visual and accessible cues are inspected
acceptance_checks.then: unread pending failed superseded disabled and selected states SHALL have text or shape cues independent of color

acceptance_checks.given: terminal item retention expires while an action attempt is nonterminal
acceptance_checks.then: foreign-key retention SHALL prevent deletion of the item or orphaning of the attempt

acceptance_checks.given: an eligible terminal item and attempts are pruned
acceptance_checks.when: a historical scan later sees the same source revision
acceptance_checks.then: a source tombstone SHALL prevent recreation until expiry or an explicit new response cycle

acceptance_checks.given: an attendee-copy RSVP PATCH uses `sendUpdates=none`
acceptance_checks.then: release evidence SHALL confirm organizer-copy response propagation without requesting broad guest update mail
acceptance_checks.verify_method: integration: disposable Google attendee-organizer conformance smoke with recorded result
